the incoming move bypasses Protect (Feint, moves flagged to ignore protection, most field-target moves), or the incoming move is a status move

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts): Burning Bulwark calls checkMoveBypassesProtect(move, source, target, false) — the blockStatus=false path, unlike Protect/Detect/Spiky Shield/Baneful Bunker's blockStatus=true default — so status-category moves are never blocked here, only damaging ones. Matches Bulbapedia's phrasing ('protects the user from physical and special moves') vs. Protect's broader 'from moves' wording. Same blockStatus=false shape as King's Shield/Mat Block.
the incoming move does not make contact

checked for a rumored 'halves damage from Fire-type moves' nuance on top of the burn — not present in Showdown's moves.ts (the condition block has only the protect-block + trySetStatus('brn') on contact, no separate onSourceModifyDamage/Fire-halving hook) nor in Bulbapedia's effect text; only the burn-on-contact payoff is real.
